text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Amiodarone inhibits P-glycoprotein (P-gp) [amiodarone:drug_interactions:0], a transporter that metabolizes and clears digoxin [digoxin:drug_interactions:1]. Consequently, co-administration with amiodarone increases serum digoxin concentrations by approximately 70% [digoxin:drug_interactions:1, amiodarone:drug_interactions:9]. Patients should have their serum digoxin levels measured and doses reduced by approximately 30–50% or halved when starting amiodarone [digoxin:drug_interactions:1, amiodarone:drug_interactions:4].
